description: An orchid flower with delicate, light pink petals stands out against a dark, shadowy background. The flower's center features a prominent yellow stigma, the reproductive part of the orchid. Abstract blue and green shapes form the work's background.
imageCaption: Image courtesy of a scanned transparency made for Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. This image has not been color proofed and may differ from the original. It will be replaced when newer photography becomes available.
title: Untitled (Flower)
